title: Annual lung cancer screening with LDCT, adults 50-80 with 20 pack-year history who currently smoke or quit within 15 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) in adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years.

action: Perform annual low-dose CT lung cancer screening

all.note: Interpreted as at least 20 pack-years; no lookback window imposed (any recorded value)

uncomputable.needs: smoking quit date (quit within the past 15 years)

any.quote: have quit within the past 15 years

all.quote: currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years

denominator.quote: adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years

numerator.quote: annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT)

uncomputable.needs: clinician judgment of a health problem substantially limiting life expectancy or ability/willingness to have curative lung surgery

exclusions.quote: develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy or the ability or willingness to have curative lung surgery
